messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The job scheduler has a deploy window on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-08-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-08]
    earlier: The job scheduler can be released on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-21 to 2025-08-08; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-21]
- The webhooks service has a deploy window on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- The reporting service has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-05]
- The authentication gateway has a deploy window on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-14]
- The product catalog has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC as of 2025-11-12. [constraint; valid 2025-11-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-12]
    earlier: The product catalog has a deploy window on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-05-02 to 2025-11-12; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2]
- Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Farah for the job scheduler handover on 2025-04-04. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-scheduler]
- Boreal announced at standup on 2026-03-13 a deploy freeze for Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 for the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-13]
- The job scheduler depends on the flags service for per-job kill switches; if the flags service is down, the job scheduler is down. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-28]
- Tomasz was on call for Team Dune from 2025-09-04 until 2025-11-03, when Farah took over as primary. [decision; valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-03]
    earlier: Tomasz is on call for Team Dune as of 2025-09-04, after Farah handed him the pager. [valid 2025-09-04 to 2025-11-03; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-04]
    earlier: Farah is on call for Team Dune as of 2025-03-31. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-09-04; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-31]
- billing-api can be released on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-24]
- The scheduler is not a Boreal service; Boreal flagged the scheduler at standup on 2026-02-04. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-04]
- INC-2025-023 was an incident involving the indexer on 2025-10-24. [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Team Dune owns the job scheduler as of 2025-04-04. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-scheduler]
    earlier: Ember owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-04; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- INC-2025-017 was caused by an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-07-09 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16 during INC-2026-009. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The job scheduler remains a Team Dune service as of 2026-01-12. [valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-12]
- After the runtime upgrade, the job scheduler's cold start time tripled. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-24]
- The root cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The root cause of INC-2026-009 was two leaders elected during a network partition. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]

Question: What was the deploy window for the scheduler before it changed?

message.reasoning:
The question asks: "What was the deploy window for the scheduler before it changed?"

Looking at memory: the job scheduler has entries:
- Current (valid 2025-08-08 to now): deploy window on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.
- Earlier (valid 2025-03-21 to 2025-08-08): released on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception.

The question asks for the previous window before it changed. So the answer: Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.
